episodes.title: What is Linguistics?
episodes.description: Introduce the study of language through its features, structural levels, and central questions.

episodes.title: Morphology
episodes.description: Examine the building blocks within words and why linguists distinguish morphemes from everyday word categories.

episodes.title: Syntax – Morphosyntax
episodes.description: Explore how words and morphemes combine into larger grammatical expressions.

episodes.title: Syntax – Trees
episodes.description: Use branching diagrams to represent sentence structure and the roles of different phrases.

episodes.title: Semantics
episodes.description: Investigate linguistic meaning, semantic relationships, and the limitations of dictionary definitions.

episodes.title: Pragmatics
episodes.description: Explore how context, conversational expectations, and grammatical politeness help convey intended meanings.

episodes.title: Sociolinguistics
episodes.description: Connect language variation and judgments about speech with social identities and inequalities.

episodes.title: Phonetics – Consonants
episodes.description: Study consonant sounds and learn how phonetic notation represents pronunciation beyond ordinary spelling.

episodes.title: Phonetics – Vowels
episodes.description: Explore vowel sounds and their representation using the International Phonetic Alphabet.

episodes.title: Phonology
episodes.description: Compare languages' systems of sound patterns and practice recognizing unfamiliar distinctions.

episodes.title: Psycholinguistics
episodes.description: Explore research methods and discoveries connecting language processing with the brain.

episodes.title: Language Acquisition
episodes.description: Compare how children and adults develop knowledge of a language.

episodes.title: Language Change and Historical Linguistics
episodes.description: Investigate language contact, processes of change, and methods for reconstructing linguistic history.

episodes.title: World Languages
episodes.description: Question language boundaries and explore how politics and unequal documentation affect linguistic diversity.

episodes.title: Computational Linguistics
episodes.description: Examine computational language tasks, natural-language processing, and biases in learned systems.

episodes.title: Writing Systems
episodes.description: Compare components of writing systems and trace their development over time.
